title: Townhouse 222 m² with a terrace and garage in Adlia
description: A 222 m² townhouse with a terrace and its own garage, 4 minutes from the sea and Kaczyński Park — for $185,000. The community is built, renovations can begin. Location: the club community is within the city, in the Adlia district. The sea and promenade — 4 minutes by car, the ELT quarter infrastructure — 3 minutes by car, the Metro City mall — 8 minutes by car. 5 minutes away is the Lech and Maria Kaczyński Park. It is always green here, with plenty of recreation areas and walking paths, a skate park and bike zones, and outdoor fitness equipment — a perfect place to walk, breathe and stay active. About the property: 222 m², 3 floors and a comfortable terrace — a kitchen-living room, 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a private garage and a green yard. It is in a bare-shell condition. About the community: a gated community of 10 townhouses. High construction quality — ventilated facades, aluminium-profile windows, ceramic brick, sturdy doors. The community is practically finished, utilities are connected — renovations can begin. Each townhouse has its own yard and garage. Nearby there is a small park, children's and sports playgrounds, and lounge areas. Price: $185,000. Eligible for a residence permit.
